---
title: "Instacart dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(flexdashboard)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("instacart")
```

Column {data-width=550}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Reorder rate vs. number of items ordered, by aisle

```{r}
instacart |>
  group_by(aisle) |>
  summarize(
    n_items = n(),
    prop_reordered = mean(reordered)) |>
  mutate(text_label = str_c(aisle, "\nItems ordered: ", n_items)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~n_items, y = ~prop_reordered, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5) |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Number of items ordered"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Proportion reordered"))
```

Column {data-width=450}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Most popular aisles

```{r}
instacart |>
  count(aisle) |>
  filter(n > 30000) |>
  mutate(aisle = fct_reorder(aisle, n)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~aisle, y = ~n, color = ~aisle, type = "bar", colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Aisle"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of items ordered"))
```

### Proportion of items reordered by hour of day

```{r}
instacart |>
  group_by(order_hour_of_day) |>
  summarize(prop_reordered = mean(reordered)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~order_hour_of_day, y = ~prop_reordered,
          type = "scatter", mode = "lines") |>
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Hour of day"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Proportion reordered"))
```
